dialogues.speaker: Annick
dialogues.text: Hello there. Care to try my new fragrances?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to make a perfume...

dialogues.speaker: Annick
dialogues.text: Of course. If you would hand me the flowers, I'll take care of the blending.

dialogues.speaker: Annick
dialogues.text: Hehe, take your time. Whenever you feel curious about fragrances, you're always welcome to stop by.

dialogues.speaker: Annick
dialogues.text: Hehe, it's all thanks to Miss Lilian's carefully cultivated flowers. Without fine ingredients, even a skilled perfumer can't create a truly refined fragrance.

dialogues.speaker: Annick
dialogues.text: Miss Lilian is quite a talented perfumer herself. She always knows how to balance each layer of scent, bringing different aromas together beautifully...

dialogues.speaker: Annick
dialogues.text: Anyway, if you ever come across flowers with a scent you really like, you can bring them to me. I can turn them into a fragrance. Being surrounded by a scent like that can really lift your mood.
